title: amyema villiflora subsp. tomentella
intro: Amyema villiflora subsp. tomentella, commonly known as the Woolly Mistletoe, is a species of mistletoe native to Australia. This plant is valued for its potential health benefits, which include anti-inflammatory and antioxidant properties that may aid in reducing inflammation and oxidative stress. The therapeutic actions of Woolly Mistletoe include its ability to modulate the immune system, exhibit antimicrobial activity, and show promise in the treatment of certain cancers and viral infections. The bioactive constituents of Amyema villiflora subsp. tomentella include alkaloids, flavonoids, and phenolic acids, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
